verdict.rationale: AMD documents first-party tooling for Instinct GPUs. AMD SMI is described as a unified user-space tool to manage and monitor GPUs and drivers. Alongside it sit the ROCm Validation Suite and Spur, a Slurm-compatible scheduler, so official operator tooling exists. However, the evidence never explicitly calls these command-line interfaces or describes AI-native/agent-oriented workflows. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a CLI (commands, flags, output formats), machine-readable/scriptable output for agents, AI-native workflow positioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.
